title: Trombone players he worked with
summary: Garland names Ory, Eddie Atkins, Honore Dutrey, George Fields and Eddie Vincent.

story.theme_name: Trombonists: who they heard, admired and learned from
story.community_name: Talking trombonists: who played the slide and how

blocks.x: Yeah, Pops played with them. And how about trombone players, besides Ory who you obviously enjoyed very much?
The trombone players, which trombone Players do you remember that you enjoyed working with?

There you are again. Poor me, (unintelligible). So many of them I worked with a lot of good ones and a lot of bad ones. You know. I got to give all -- old Red the devil, which belongs to him. Ory, and I got to give Eddie Atkins, I got to give Honore Dutrey -- I'm calling trombone players. George Fields --
Eddie Vincent, I'm way back -- I'm way back, little before your time.
Those were good trombone players. I'm calling them. I better stop there, that's enough.
